notes: Sermon extract. Bible Characters (1902) is a multi-author compilation; the Moody section is headed 'Bible Characters described in his soul-winning sermons', and the editor's introduction says he 'culled from their utterances choice selections'. Several pieces are only a page long. No text is stated. Opening words: “I have often thought what a night Barabbas must have spent just before the day when Christ was crucified. As the sun goes down, he says to himself: “Tomorrow—only tomorrow—and …”
